_about: The one place to change wording, names, colours and rules that differ between programmes. After editing, run: python3 tools/build.py (it rewrites Config.gs, Styles.html and the seed files).

scaleHelp.1: Several criteria are not met, or a critical error. Reattempt after feedback.
scaleHelp.2: One or more criteria are not met. Reattempt after feedback.
scaleHelp.3: Meets the criteria. Minor gaps that do not affect student safety or role clarity.
scaleHelp.4: Meets every criterion and shows independent judgement and reflection beyond the prompt.

partial: Some criteria are met; the trainee reattempts after feedback
rework: Not there yet, or a critical error; the trainee reattempts
exempt: Not needed, for example prior experience

ask: Ask your mentor or TL before using any AI tool for this task.
no: Do this task with your own thinking and effort. No AI tools.
yes: AI may be used. Follow the task guidelines and be ready to explain how you used it.

aiRule: Never enter student names, initials with identifying details, records, grades, meeting notes, disclosures, or anything that could identify a student, parent or colleague into an AI tool, even when AI use is allowed.
criticalErrors: Promising confidentiality where it cannot be kept
"I won't tell anyone, I promise" after a disclosure of harm
Failing to escalate a safeguarding or risk indicator
Noting a self-harm remark but not informing the WBC/TL the same day
Questioning a teacher or family member about a disclosure instead of reporting it
Telling a parent "I think she has anxiety" or "he is ADHD"
Repeating one sibling's confidential disclosures to parents while supporting the other
Private messaging a student on a personal phone or social media
Entering identifiable student information into an AI tool
Pasting a student's meeting notes into a chatbot for a summary

checklist.title: Real student work: pre-task safeguarding and consent checklist
checklist.intro: Complete this for every real student before the task begins. Use a student code, never the student's name. It does not replace the school's safeguarding, consent, confidentiality or referral procedures. If you are unsure, pause and ask your TL or mentor.
groups: The student has been approved by my TL or mentor.
The task is appropriate for this student and does not go beyond my current level of training or role.
The student knows the interaction is part of my Student Champion training.
The student knows the meeting may be observed by the mentor or TL for training and feedback.
The student understands the purpose and what will happen with the information shared.
The student has agreed voluntarily and knows they can decline, pause or stop at any point without any consequence.
The parent or guardian has been informed, or consent obtained, where school policy requires it.
I have confirmed the required process with my TL or mentor.
I have confirmed which records I may access for this task.
I will use only the information that is necessary and permitted.
No student information will be copied, downloaded, shared or stored outside approved school systems.
All my notes and submissions use the student code, not the student's name.
I understand the limits of confidentiality: information may need to be shared for a safeguarding, safety or child-welfare concern.
I know who to approach for support or escalation, including the WBC and my TL or mentor, and I will consult them at once if I am unsure how to handle something a student discloses.
